generate.title: Generate todos with AI
generate.placeholder: Describe a feature… e.g. “User profile page with avatar upload”
generate.mockHint: Mock AI: each line of your text becomes one todo.
generate.suggested: Suggested todos · nothing is saved yet
generate.empty: The AI did not suggest any todos. Try describing the feature in more detail.
generate.discardBody: The suggested todos have not been saved. They will be lost.
generate.replaceBody: Generating again replaces the todos below, including your edits.
generate.promptMin: Describe the feature in at least {{min}} characters
generate.countInvalid: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}

planDialog.title: Plan a sprint with AI
planDialog.missing_one: {{count}} suggested todo is no longer in the backlog and was skipped.
planDialog.missing_other: {{count}} suggested todos are no longer in the backlog and were skipped.
planDialog.noneLeft: None of the suggested todos is in the backlog any more. Suggest a new plan.
planDialog.capacityInvalid: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}

improve.title: Improve {{key}}
improve.intro: The AI proposes a clearer title, description and acceptance criteria. Pick what to keep, then apply.
improve.nothingSelected: Select at least one change to apply.
improve.invalid: The AI answer could not be read. Try again.
improve.tooLong: Some proposed text is too long and was skipped.

estimate.title: Estimate story points
estimate.intro: The AI suggests story points for todos that have none. Only valid point values are accepted.
estimate.none: Every todo in the backlog already has an estimate.
estimate.limited_one: Only the first {{count}} unestimated todo is sent.
estimate.limited_other: Only the first {{count}} unestimated todos are sent.
estimate.noValid: The AI did not return any valid estimate.

standup.title: Stand-up
standup.intro: Built from todos completed since yesterday and todos in progress. Not sent to the AI.
standup.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it.
standup.heading: Stand-up · {{date}}
standup.blockedHint: Todos labelled “blocked” and overdue todos count as blockers.
